title: CheatCheck
description: CheatCheck — ultimate investigation tool for admins. It allows you to freeze suspects instantly! 🧊
body:
🛡️ CheatCheck System
CheatCheck — ultimate investigation tool for admins. It allows you to freeze suspects instantly! 🧊

Key Features:

🚫 Total Freeze: Blocks movement, jumping, and camera rotation.

🛡️ God Mode: Protected from attacks, arrows, and TNT.

📵 No Commands: Blocks escape commands (except /msg).

Commands:
/ch <player> — ⚡ Freeze target
/lch <player> — ✅ Release target
